name: kimi-skill-creator
title_zh: 从能跑到好用的 Kimi Skill 打磨台
tagline_zh: 写 Skill 最怕触发不准、描述含糊、打包出错。这个助手自带测试与优化流程，把「能用」推到「好用」。
tagline_en: Stuck with skills that misfire or underperform? This helper tests, tunes triggers, and packages .skill.
desc_en: Create, test, and optimize Kimi Code skills. Use when creating a skill, editing one, testing if a skill works, optimizing triggering, or packaging a .skill file. Triggers: "create skill", "new skill", "edit skill", "test skill", "skill not triggering", "optimize description", "package skill", "SKILL.md", "whenToUse", "verify skill", "skill ready to ship". NOT for: AGENTS.md rules, one-off prompts,
why_zh: 不是给模板，是给一套可执行的验证闭环：写完即测、测完即改、改完即包。
why_en: It's a verification loop, not a template dump: write, test, fix, package. Each step tightens triggering and output until the.
limit_zh: 只服务 Kimi Code 的 Skill 开发，不处理 AGENTS.md 规则或一次性 prompt。
limit_en: For Kimi Code skills only—no AGENTS.md or one-off prompts. Needs a working draft; won't ideate from zero.
title_en: Kimi Skill workbench: build, test, ship
